[[Rand Stormweaver]] is a bosslike foe found in the northeast corner of [[Justiciar Thommis]]'s room of [[Slavers' Exile]]. He is accompanied by a small group of [[Stone Summit]] dwarves, and a patrol of [[Wretched Wolf|Wretched Wolves]] occasionally passes by his location. When he is defeated, a [[Chest of the Slaver (Rand Stormweaver)]] appears at his spawn location.
